context.analysis:
## Overview
A cross-border telehealth platform delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. The architecture enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using GCP.

## Key Elements
* Patients (EU & US)
* Licensed Clinicians
* Pharmacies (EU/US)
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform (Software System)
* External Pharmacies (EU national gateways and US pharmacy networks)
* Regional Identity & Consent Providers (eIDAS/EU login and US IAM)
* AI Model Providers / Medical Devices (External AI inference APIs)

## Relationships
* Patients -> Cross-Border Telehealth Platform via HTTPS / WebSockets (adaptive codec)
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> External Pharmacies via TLS / Mutual TLS
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> AI Model Providers via HTTPS (REST/gRPC with payload masking)

## Technology Stack
* Cloud Platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) deployed in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for data residency
* Infrastructure & Deployment: Terraform for Infrastructure-as-Code and ArgoCD for GitOps multi-region pipelines
* Security & Encryption: Cloud KMS with Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), TLS 1.3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), and Sigstore/cosign for model verification
* Observability & Logging: Cloud Logging and BigQuery for immutable, regionally segregated audit trails

## Rationale
Zero-trust regional isolation guarantees compliance with GDPR and HIPAA by keeping EU health data in the EU and US data in the US. Explicit consent tunnels and payload masking satisfy EU MDR traceability and cross-border privacy mandates.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
[Cross-Border Telehealth Platform] is a secure telehealth system delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. It enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using GCP regions `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.

## Key Elements
- Patients [person, context]
- Licensed Clinicians [person, context]
- Pharmacies [externalSystem, context]
- External Pharmacies [externalSystem, context]
- Regional Identity & Consent Providers [externalSystem, context]
- AI Model Providers / Medical Devices [externalSystem, context]
- Patient Web/Mobile App [container]
- Clinician Portal [container]
- API Gateway & Routing Service [container]
- Core Telehealth Service [container]
- E-Prescription Interoperability Service [container]
- AI Symptom Checker Service [container]
- Database Cluster [container]

## Relationships
- Patients -> Cross-Border Telehealth Platform via HTTPS / WebSockets (adaptive codec)
- Licensed Clinicians -> Cross-Border Telehealth Platform via HTTPS
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> External Pharmacies via TLS / Mutual TLS
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> AI Model Providers / Medical Devices via HTTPS (REST/gRPC with payload masking)
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Regional Identity & Consent Providers via OAuth2 / OpenID Connect

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider for regional isolation in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`
- Flutter / React Native: Powers the Patient Web/Mobile App with local state caching for unstable connections
- React SPA: Powers the Clinician Portal
- Envoy Proxy / Istio: Manages API gateway routing, Istio service mesh mTLS, and Canary deployments
- Node.js / Go: Powers the Core Telehealth Service handling consultations and consent
- Spring Boot / Apache Camel: Powers the E-Prescription Interoperability Service translating HL7 FHIR and national EU standards
- Python / FastAPI: Powers the AI Symptom Checker Service with local PII/PHI masking
- Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL: Regional data stores secured with Google Cloud KMS CMEK
- GKE & WebRTC SFU: Container orchestration and adaptive bitrate video streaming

## Rationale
The architecture strictly enforces GDPR and HIPAA via regional GCP isolation (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`) and Envoy/Istio security controls. Containerized microservices ensure high availability under unstable internet connections and maintain strict traceability for AI medical device compliance.

Patient Web/Mobile App.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform delivers secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients using GCP. The Patient Web/Mobile App provides an offline-first, compliant interface to ensure accessibility and continuous care for rural users.

## Key Elements
- Patients (Person)
- Patient Web/Mobile App (Container, Flutter / React Native)
- Local Secure Storage Component (Component, SQLite / Encrypted Shared Preferences)
- Consent Management UI Component (Component)
- Symptom Checker Client Component (Component)
- Video Consultation Client Component (Component)
- API Gateway & Routing Service (Container, Envoy Proxy / Istio)

## Relationships
- Patients -> Patient Web/Mobile App [HTTPS / WebSockets (adaptive codec)]
- Patient Web/Mobile App -> API Gateway & Routing Service [HTTPS / WebSockets]
- Local Secure Storage Component -> API Gateway & Routing Service [HTTPS (REST) / mTLS]
- Consent Management UI Component -> Local Secure Storage Component [Local Encrypted Write / Read]
- Video Consultation Client Component -> API Gateway & Routing Service [WebSockets / HTTPS]

## Technology Stack
- Flutter / React Native: Cross-platform mobile development for unified patient experience
- SQLite / Encrypted Shared Preferences: Local secure storage for offline-first resilience
- WebRTC with adaptive codecs: Video streaming optimized for low-bandwidth connections (<300 kbit/s)
- OpenTelemetry: Client-side telemetry with strict PII/PHI redaction
- Android Keystore / iOS Keychain: Hardware-backed key derivation for client encryption

## Rationale
This architecture ensures GDPR and HIPAA compliance while supporting offline triage and encrypted local caching for unstable rural connections. Strict hardware-backed security and regional data routing guarantee patient trust and regulatory adherence.

Clinician Portal.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform is a healthcare system delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. The Clinician Portal component enables licensed medical professionals to manage consultations, review traceable AI recommendations, and issue cross-border e-prescriptions securely.

## Key Elements
- **Clinician Portal**: React SPA providing the clinician user interface (Hosted on GCP Cloud Storage / Cloud CDN).
- **Consultation Workspace Component**: Manages live video feeds and low-bandwidth fallback tools.
- **AI Audit Reviewer Component**: Displays traceable AI symptom-checker recommendations and model versions.
- **E-Prescription Dashboard Component**: Interfaces with regional standards and features a Cross-Border Pharmacy Routing Indicator.
- **Portal Navigation Shell Component**: Manages layout routing, role-based view rendering, and error boundaries.
- **Portal State Management Component**: Redux Toolkit/React Query managing session state, RBAC, and inactivity timeouts without caching PHI/PII.
- **API Client Component**: Axios/WebSockets client handling secure egress with OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.

## Relationships
- Clinician Portal -> GCP Cloud Storage / Cloud CDN: Serves static SPA assets globally per region [HTTPS]
- Clinician Portal -> Regional Identity & Consent Providers: Authenticates clinicians via OIDC with short-lived JWTs [HTTPS]
- Clinician Portal -> API Gateway & Routing Service: Routes all outbound traffic via API Client Component [HTTPS]
- Portal Navigation Shell Component -> Consultation Workspace Component: Renders active consultation view [React Props / State]
- Portal Navigation Shell Component -> AI Audit Reviewer Component: Renders audit logs view [React Props / State]
- Portal Navigation Shell Component -> E-Prescription Dashboard Component: Renders prescription and routing view [React Props / State]
- Consultation Workspace Component -> API Client Component: Fetches video stream metadata [HTTPS / WebSockets]
- AI Audit Reviewer Component -> API Client Component: Queries traceable AI logs [HTTPS]
- E-Prescription Dashboard Component -> API Client Component: Submits prescriptions [HTTPS]

## Technology Stack
- **React SPA**: Powers the Clinician Portal UI for rapid component rendering and modular architecture.
- **Redux Toolkit / React Query**: Manages local session caching, RBAC, and secure state handling.
- **Axios / WebSockets**: Handles asynchronous communication and real-time data streaming.
- **GCP Cloud Storage & Cloud CDN**: Provides low-latency static asset delivery in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.
- **OpenTelemetry**: Enables Real User Monitoring (RUM) and distributed tracing for client-side observability.

## Rationale
This architecture ensures secure, low-latency access for clinicians while strictly enforcing regional data privacy and compliance mandates. Centralizing communication through an API client and leveraging GCP Cloud CDN supports high availability and regulatory accountability across EU and US jurisdictions.

API Gateway & Routing Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. It enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using GCP across `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU & US)
- Licensed Clinicians
- Patient Web/Mobile App (Flutter / React Native)
- Clinician Portal (React SPA)
- API Gateway & Routing Service (Envoy Proxy / Istio)
- Core Telehealth Service (Node.js / Go)
- E-Prescription Interoperability Service (Spring Boot / Apache Camel)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI)
- Database Cluster (Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL)

## Relationships
- Patient Web/Mobile App -> API Gateway & Routing Service: Sends client requests [HTTPS / WebSockets]
- Clinician Portal -> API Gateway & Routing Service: Sends clinician requests [HTTPS]
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> Core Telehealth Service: Routes consultation and consent requests [gRPC / mTLS]
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> E-Prescription Interoperability Service: Routes e-prescription requests [gRPC / mTLS]
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> AI Symptom Checker Service: Routes symptom check requests [gRPC / mTLS]
- Core Telehealth Service -> Database Cluster: Persists regional health data [TCP / CMEK]

## Technology Stack
- Envoy Proxy / Istio: Manages regional API gateway routing, Istio service mesh mTLS, and Canary deployments.
- GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Enforces regional physical data residency for GDPR and HIPAA.
- Redis: Provides regional rate-limiting and consent state management.
- Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL: Secures regional data stores with Google Cloud KMS CMEK.

## Rationale
Regionalized gateway deployments and strict geo-routing guarantee that EU and US health data never cross borders without explicit consent. This decoupled, resilient architecture maintains availability for rural users while ensuring regulatory compliance under GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR.

Core Telehealth Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. It ensures strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and resilience for unstable internet connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients
- Licensed Clinicians
- Pharmacies
- Regional Identity & Consent Providers
- AI Model Providers / Medical Devices
- Patient Web/Mobile App (Flutter / React Native)
- Clinician Portal (React SPA)
- API Gateway & Routing Service (Envoy Proxy / Istio)
- Core Telehealth Service (Go)
- E-Prescription Interoperability Service (Spring Boot / Apache Camel)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI)
- Database Cluster (Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL)

## Relationships
- Patients -> Patient Web/Mobile App (HTTPS / WebSockets (adaptive codec))
- Patient Web/Mobile App -> API Gateway & Routing Service (HTTPS / WebSockets)
- Clinician Portal -> API Gateway & Routing Service (HTTPS)
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> Core Telehealth Service (gRPC / mTLS)
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> E-Prescription Interoperability Service (gRPC / mTLS)
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> AI Symptom Checker Service (gRPC / mTLS)
- Core Telehealth Service -> Database Cluster (TCP / CMEK)
- E-Prescription Interoperability Service -> External Pharmacies (TLS / Mutual TLS)
- AI Symptom Checker Service -> AI Model Providers / Medical Devices (HTTPS (REST/gRPC with payload masking))
- Core Telehealth Service -> Regional Identity & Consent Providers (OAuth2 / OpenID Connect)

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` regions for strict data residency.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Regional container orchestration ensuring isolated workloads per geography.
- Istio Service Mesh & Envoy Proxy: Manages traffic routing, mTLS, and canary deployments.
- Go: Powers high-performance internal microservices within the Core Telehealth Service.
- Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL: Regional data stores secured via Google Cloud KMS CMEK.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces GDPR and HIPAA compliance by isolating regional data processing and storage within specific GCP zones. It ensures high availability and low-bandwidth resilience for rural patients through adaptive WebSockets and localized session handling.

E-Prescription Interoperability Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients using GCP. It enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using GCP Cloud Spanner, Cloud KMS, and isolated services.

## Key Elements
- **E-Prescription Interoperability Service** (Spring Boot / Apache Camel)
- **Prescription Router Component** (Apache Camel EIP)
- **HL7 FHIR Translator Component** (Java / HAPI FHIR)
- **EU National Gateway Adapter Component** (Apache Camel / Spring Integration)
- **Prescription Audit & Status Service Component** (Spring Boot / Data JPA)
- **Security & Token Validation Component** (Spring Security / OAuth2)
- **Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) & Retry Handler Component** (Google Cloud Pub/Sub)
- **External Pharmacies** (EU national gateways and US pharmacy networks)

## Relationships
- API Gateway & Routing Service -> Security & Token Validation Component [gRPC / mTLS]
- Security & Token Validation Component -> Prescription Router Component [Direct / In-memory]
- Prescription Router Component -> EU National Gateway Adapter Component [Direct / In-memory]
- Prescription Router Component -> HL7 FHIR Translator Component [Direct / In-memory]
- Prescription Router Component -> Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) & Retry Handler Component [AMQP / Pub/Sub]
- EU National Gateway Adapter Component -> External Pharmacies [TLS / Mutual TLS with digital signatures]

## Technology Stack
- **Spring Boot & Apache Camel**: Powers message routing, enterprise integration patterns, and microservices logic.
- **Java & HAPI FHIR**: Implements HL7 FHIR standard translations for US prescription compliance.
- **Google Cloud Pub/Sub**: Manages resilient asynchronous dead-letter queues with CMEK encryption.
- **Google Cloud KMS / Cloud HSM**: Provides hardware-backed keys for digital signatures and data-at-rest encryption.

## Rationale
This architecture ensures secure, compliant cross-border e-prescription delivery by isolating translation and routing logic behind robust security validation and cryptographic non-repudiation. Utilizing GCP managed services and regional data controls guarantees adherence to GDPR and HIPAA mandates without sacrificing system reliability.

AI Symptom Checker Service.analysis:
## Overview
A cross-border telehealth platform delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients with strict regional data residency. The AI Symptom Checker Service ensures regulatory compliance and resilience in low-bandwidth environments via local PII masking and fallback logic.

## Key Elements
* Patients [person, context]
* Licensed Clinicians [person, context]
* AI Symptom Checker Service [container, container] (Python / FastAPI)
* Inference Orchestrator Component [component] (Python / FastAPI)
* PII/PHI Masking Component [component] (Python / SpaCy/Regex)
* Audit & Traceability Component [component] (Python / SQLAlchemy)
* AI Model Providers / Medical Devices [externalSystem, context]
* Database Cluster [container, container] (Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL)

## Relationships
* Patients -> Cross-Border Telehealth Platform [HTTPS / WebSockets (adaptive codec)]
* API Gateway & Routing Service -> AI Symptom Checker Service [gRPC / mTLS]
* Inference Orchestrator Component -> PII/PHI Masking Component [In-memory function call]
* Inference Orchestrator Component -> Audit & Traceability Component [Asynchronous gRPC / Database write]
* AI Symptom Checker Service -> AI Model Providers / Medical Devices [HTTPS (REST/gRPC with payload masking)]
* AI Symptom Checker Service -> Database Cluster [TCP / CMEK]

## Technology Stack
* Python / FastAPI: Powers the AI Symptom Checker Service for rapid asynchronous request handling.
* SpaCy/Regex: Enables local PII/PHI masking to satisfy GDPR and HIPAA.
* Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Deploys microservices across `europe-west3` and `us-central1` with GCP VPC Service Controls.
* Google Cloud Spanner / PostgreSQL: Secures regional data storage using Google Cloud KMS CMEK.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces strict regional data isolation and localized PII masking to comply with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR mandates. Furthermore, it incorporates robust circuit breakers and lightweight fallbacks to maintain system availability for rural users on unstable connections.
